title: Duck jumps onto a quadruped
goal: Train the Microduck to land with both feet on a quadruped's back and remain upright after a fully disclosed, deterministic launch assist.

quadruped.role: stationary landing platform for the first reproducible version

training.algorithm: staged landing curriculum with randomized assisted ballistic spawns
stages: calibrate and bound the minimum launch assist needed to reach the target
two-foot contact inside the back target across randomized launches

disclosure: The quadruped begins in and holds a fixed standing pose. The stock XL330-class behavior could not produce the required unassisted rise, so a deterministic launch velocity is applied once at episode start and will be stated on-screen. No force is applied in flight. The learned component is the randomized two-foot landing and stable hold.
